payload.title: C4 Scoped file-only priming endpoint with auto-prime
payload.description: POST /api/newsroom/curation/priming {query,variables}->{data}, reusing web_api priming types on a publication-scoped PrimingService over S3ConsoleStorage; refuse other publications' list/classifiers/draft ids before any read; transform -> 'no hosted transformer'; idempotent accept; slice-1 size cap ~1 MB with clean failure; after accept the lab applies the examples (auto-prime) so suggestions use them.
